name: Xalt
identity: Long rounded cobalt BLUE head and neck, enormous touching circular YELLOW eye surrounds, glossy round BLACK pupils with dark RED iris rings and white glints. Small flat blue nose; broad projecting RED beak-like closed lips with curved smile seam. Several RED triangular spines along the rear head. Thick rolled YELLOW collar with a small red/black oval brooch in yellow rim, RED shirt. BLUE bare arms/hands; extend RED trousers and yellow boots. No crown, hair, cape or boxing gloves. Preserve the round wide-eyed expression and red rear spines.
intro: INTRO: stand alert with enormous round eyes looking right; excited small bounce with two low knees bent and palms up; tap the oval collar brooch with one blue fingertip while the other hand rises; settle to a bright-eyed confident guard. Brooch remains fixed to collar, no effects.
cast: CAST: eyes widen and red lips purse while knees compress; head draws back, cheeks puff and both hands brace at waist; powerful open-beaked mouth SPIT to RIGHT as neck shoots forward and rear spines tilt with head, elbows held back; mouth closes and head recoils smoothly into guard. No palm shot, projectile or effects drawn.
defeat: DEFEAT START: big eyes blink in disbelief as red rear spines tilt; wobble on both knees with arms windmilling but connected; seated collapse with both feet forward; roll onto side with head LEFT and feet RIGHT. DEFEAT FLOOR: fully side-lying body with yellow eyes still open; one hand reaches weakly forward along floor; hand drops and red mouth slackens; settle side-lying with spine silhouette intact. DEFEAT REST: eyelids grow heavy; eyes close to thin yellow slits; fingers relax; completely still side-lying rest. Brooch and red costume retained.
appearanceRule: Preserve the same costume and face across every frame. Same-hue limited palette shading; no white clothing patches, text, floating effects, detached accessories or additional actors.
unlockRule: Defeat this fighter in its campaign encounter to recruit for P1 play.
